diagnosis: The extend_device_session view allows extending the validity window of Knox authentication tokens by passing a token_id in the URL. The view looks up AuthToken.objects.get(pk=token_id) without checking that token.user == request.user. An attacker can extend the lifetime of compromised or expired tokens belonging to other users, maintaining persistent unauthorized API access.
exploit_request:
POST /api/auth/tokens/812/extend/ HTTP/1.1
Host: api.cloudwork.io
Authorization: Token 4f92bc...
Content-Type: application/json

{"extend_days": 90}
